title: 红颜

content_zh:
夏季的莲花台上，处处飘着莲花的香气，令人窒息。再清高出尘的花，开得多了，就变得霸道了。在这座台城上，再也闻不到别的花香。
蒋娇儿想起昨晚三哥偷偷潜入台城后对她说的话。
“娇儿，你可以回家了！”
“大哥他们正打算迎回姜元，他就是当年大公子与长平公主的儿子！我们蒋家又有希望了！”
昏暗的灯光下，蒋娇儿木然的望着振奋的蒋珍，她轻轻咳了两声，把痒意压下去，道：“哥哥，要娇儿做什么？”
蒋珍的脸就变得僵硬了，他刚才的狂喜像假的一样从他脸上被揭去，他露出一个拙劣的、轻松的笑来，他抚摸着蒋娇儿的脸，像小时候哄她一样，柔声道：“娇儿，大哥对你说……珍重。”
蒋娇儿看向窗外的水池，这宫中处处是回廊、处处是水，莲花的枝蔓也长得到处都是，散发着臭味。
“不！不，娇儿，看着哥哥！”蒋珍捧住她的脸，轻声说：“娇儿，哥哥是要接你回家的……”他张张嘴，“大哥……也想接你回家。”但想好的话在面对蒋娇儿似乎明悟一切的目光下却一个字也吐不出来，他只能避开她的眼睛，干巴巴的说：“你、你在八月十四日，从台城最低的地方跳下去……”说完这句，他猛得抬起头，急切的说：“哥哥会让人在下面接住你！会事先把那个地方的土给翻松！你找最低的地方，跳下去不会有事的！最多摔断腿，但你不会死！我会立刻找人把你接回家给你治好！然后，你就可以留在家里，没有人知道……”你还活着。
在寂静的宫室中，这对年过半百的兄妹黯然相对。
蒋珍连目光也不敢与蒋娇相对，他曾在台城与鲁王拍案大骂，也曾在他国公卿面前侃侃而谈，但此时此刻，他没有在鲁王前的勇气，也没有在公卿前的口舌。他只能僵硬的坐在蒋娇面前，等她应一声。
“……”蒋娇轻轻笑了，天真的就像当年那个将要被家人送进王宫的小女孩，“好啊，娇儿……早就想念家中的人了。哥哥、嫂嫂……还有小彪儿，他……也已经娶妻生子了吧？”
烈日当头，四周没有一丝风，宫人与侍卫全都躲到了阴凉处。
宫内的钟响过九遍，蒋娇往将台望去，问宫人：“大夫们都已经出宫了吗？”
宫人不明白蒋娇为什么问这个，她们深居内宫，怎么会知道？不过钟响九遍，该是要出宫了吧？虽然鲁王已经很久都不见诸位大夫了，但大夫们还是要到王宫中来的。
“应该快出去了吧。”宫人道，“夫人是想见蒋大夫吗？”
蒋娇似有若无的嗯了一声，勉力支撑起来，把手递给宫人，“扶我出去。”
夫人已经有两年不曾出门了。宫人连忙唤来轿子，把蒋娇托上去。“去那边。”蒋娇指着将台。
将台是点将的地方，只是鲁王宫已经有几十年未曾出过兵，早就沦为宴戏之所。它是整个王宫最高的地方。
轿子摇摇晃晃的往将台去，炙烈的阳光洒下来，让蒋娇有些头晕。她撑着额头，似乎每向前一步，身上都变得更轻松一点，好像束缚她的东西正在一点一滴的消失。
将台之上没有侍卫看守，还能看到被风卷来的一两朵枯荷落在石台角落。

蒋娇按着轿子：“停下。”
宫人茫然道：“夫人，大王不在这里。”
蒋娇笑起来，“我当然知道！停下！”
宫人只得将轿子落下，扶蒋娇下轿，“夫人……是想从这里看蒋大夫？不如奴出去送信？”
“不用。”蒋娇扶着宫人的手一步步走上将台，居高临下，前方不远处就能看到一辆辆牛车缓缓从宫门口驶离。
这其中，可有她的大哥？
蒋娇露出一抹天真的笑。
她猛得推开宫人扶她的手，冲上去！站在城墙之上！
宫人吓得尖叫：“夫人！！夫人啊！！”
那尖利的呼喊穿云裂帛！
宫门处的人纷纷闻声抬头往上看。
“那是谁！！”
“什么人在将台上？”
“侍卫！侍卫！！”
蒋淑发现牛车停下了，掀起车帘，“怎么不动？”
却见从人早就跪在地上，满脸是泪，遥遥指着城墙，“是……是小姐！是小姐啊！”
“什么？！”蒋淑猛得跳下车，鞋都顾不上穿，他赤足奔到墙壁之下，身旁都是举手搭凉棚往上看的人。

content_en:
On the lotus platform in summer, the fragrance of lotus flowers is wafting everywhere, which is suffocating. No matter how noble a flower is, the more it blooms, the more overbearing it becomes. In this Taicheng, you can no longer smell the fragrance of other flowers.
Jiang Jiaoer remembered what her third brother said to her after sneaking into Taicheng last night.
"Jiao'er, you can go home!"
"Brother, they are planning to welcome Jiang Yuan back. He is the son of the eldest son and Princess Changping! Our Jiang family has hope again!"
Under the dim light, Jiang Jiaoer looked blankly at the excited Jiang Zhen. She coughed twice, suppressed the itching, and said, "Brother, what do you want Jiaoer to do?"
Jiang Zhen's face became stiff, and the ecstasy he had felt just now was removed from his face as if it were fake. He showed a clumsy, relaxed smile. He caressed Jiang Jiaoer's face, like coaxing her when she was a child, and said softly: "Jiaoer, eldest brother tells you... take care of yourself."
Jiang Jiaoer looked at the pool outside the window. There were corridors and water everywhere in the palace, and lotus branches and vines grew everywhere, exuding a stinky smell.
"No! No, Jiao'er, look at brother!" Jiang Zhen held her face and whispered: "Jiao'er, brother wants to take you home..." He opened his mouth, "Big brother... also wants to take you home." But facing Jiang Jiao'er's eyes that seemed to understand everything, he couldn't say a single word. He could only avoid her eyes and said dryly: "You, you went from the lowest level in Taicheng on August 14th. Jump down somewhere..." After saying this, he raised his head and said urgently: "Brother will let someone catch you down there! I will loosen the soil in that place in advance! You will be fine if you jump down to the lowest place! You may break your leg at most, but you won't die! Then, you can stay at home and no one will know..." You are still alive.
In the quiet palace, the half-century-old brother and sister looked at each other sadly.
Jiang Zhen didn't even dare to look at Jiang Jiao. He had quarreled with King Lu in Taicheng and had a talk in front of the ministers of other countries. But at this moment, he did not have the courage in front of King Lu, nor the tongue in front of the ministers. He could only sit stiffly in front of Jiang Jiao, waiting for her to respond.
"..." Jiang Jiao smiled softly, as innocently as the little girl who was about to be sent to the palace by her family, "Okay, Jiao'er... I have long missed my family. My brother, sister-in-law... and little Biao'er, he... has already married a wife and has children, right?"
The sun was scorching, and there was no wind around. The palace residents and guards all hid in the shade.
The bell in the palace rang nine times. Jiang Jiao looked towards the general stage and asked the palace people: "Have all the officials left the palace?"
The palace people didn't understand why Jiang Jiao asked this. How could they know if they lived deep in the inner palace? But after the bell rings nine times, it’s time to leave the palace, right? Although King Lu has not seen the officials for a long time, the officials still have to come to the palace.
"You should be leaving soon." The palace attendant said, "Does Madam want to see Dr. Jiang?"
Jiang Jiao gave a vague hum, managed to support herself, and handed her hand to the palace attendant, "Help me out."
Madam has not left home for two years. The palace servants quickly called for a sedan and put Jiang Jiao on it. "Go over there." Jiang Jiao pointed to the general platform.
The general platform is the place where generals are ordered, but the Lu palace has not sent troops for decades and has long been reduced to a place for banquets and performances. It is the highest place in the entire palace.
The sedan swayed toward the general stage, and the scorching sunlight shone down, making Jiang Jiao feel dizzy. She held her forehead, and it seemed that with every step forward, her body became lighter, as if the things that restrained her were disappearing bit by bit.
There were no guards guarding the general platform, and one or two dead lotus flowers blown by the wind could be seen falling on the corner of the stone platform.
Jiang Jiao pressed the sedan chair: "Stop."
The palace man said blankly: "Madam, the king is not here."
Jiang Jiao laughed, "Of course I know! Stop it.! "
The palace attendant had no choice but to put the sedan down and help Jiang Jiao get out of the sedan, "Madam... do you want to see Doctor Jiang from here? Why don't you go out and deliver the message? "
"Need not. "Jiang Jiao held the palace servant's hand and walked up to the general stage step by step. She was looking down from a high position. Not far ahead, she could see bullock carts slowly driving away from the palace gate.
Is there her eldest brother among them?
Jiang Jiao showed an innocent smile.
She violently pushed away the palace man's hand holding her and rushed forward! Stand on the city wall!
The palace man was so frightened that he screamed: "Madam! ! Madam! ! "
That sharp cry pierced the clouds and cracked the silk!
People at the palace gate looked up after hearing the sound.
"Who is that! ! "
"Who is on the platform? "
"Guard! Guard! ! "
Jiang Shu noticed that the bullock cart had stopped and raised the curtain, "Why don't you move? "
But I saw that the servant was already kneeling on the ground, with tears on his face, pointing to the city wall in the distance, "Yes... it's Miss!" It's the lady! "
"What? ! "Jiang Shu jumped out of the car so hard that he didn't even bother to put on his shoes. He ran barefoot under the wall, surrounded by people who raised their hands to build an awning and looked up.
